[VELOCITY ONLINE]

𝘾𝙊𝙉𝙏𝙍𝙊𝙇𝙎
To enable super speed, press CTRL or Toggle Run.
To punch, press F or Toggle Punch. 
To run on wall, press Spacebar when you're near the wall. Wall-running isn't available for mobile since mobile platform is in development.
Select suit in your inventory, press V or Toggle Suit to equip your suit.

𝑾𝑨𝑹𝑵𝑰𝑵𝑮
X-Composites are not permanent so avoid from being decimated or else you're going to lose it if you die and leave the game.

𝑻𝑼𝑻𝑶𝑹𝑰𝑨𝑳
To earn cash, you need to run or defeat a player by enabling PVP on the right corner of your screen. 
You can earn more cash through running by amplifying your speed through an armor or X-Composite.
